revenueModel.text: Enterprises pay for software-as-a-service access to marketing and data platform enabling personalized marketing across multiple channels.
revenueModel.evidence: We empower our customers to target, connect and engage consumers through software that delivers personalized marketing across all addressable channels, including email, social media, web, chat, Connected TV ("CTV") and video, among others.
